svg.title: YOLOv1-T
svg.desc: Detection; 448 × 448 RGB; 20 classes; batch 1; unfused eval. Every cfg layer is shown.
svg.text: Detection; 448 × 448 RGB; 20 classes; batch 1; unfused eval. Every cfg layer is shown.
L = cfg layer index. Matching F labels continue the same tensor across columns. Full routes remain visible.

g.data-description: yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 0: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [-1]; output [1, 16, 448, 448]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 1: MaxPool2d 2×2, s=2; inputs [0]; output [1, 16, 224, 224]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 2: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [1]; output [1, 32, 224, 224]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 3: MaxPool2d 2×2, s=2; inputs [2]; output [1, 32, 112, 112]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 4: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [3]; output [1, 64, 112, 112]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 5: MaxPool2d 2×2, s=2; inputs [4]; output [1, 64, 56, 56]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 6: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [5]; output [1, 128, 56, 56]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 7: MaxPool2d 2×2, s=2; inputs [6]; output [1, 128, 28, 28]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 8: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [7]; output [1, 256, 28, 28]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 9: MaxPool2d 2×2, s=2; inputs [8]; output [1, 256, 14, 14]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 10: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [9]; output [1, 512, 14, 14]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 11: MaxPool2d 2×2, s=2; inputs [10]; output [1, 512, 7, 7]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 12: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [11]; output [1, 1024, 7, 7]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 13: Conv 3×3, s=1 + norm + leaky; inputs [12]; output [1, 256, 7, 7]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 14: Flatten + Linear; inputs [13]; output [1, 1470]
yolov1-tiny.cfg layer 15: Raw detection head; inputs [14]; output [1, 1470]
Conv2d: k, stride and channels from layer label
g.text: k, stride and channels from layer label

g.data-description: Darknet normalization: Only layers labeled + norm
Activation: leaky: LeakyReLU(0.1); linear: identity

g.text: Norm layers: bias=False. Without norm: bias=True.
Mish uses its separate definition when present.

g.data-description: Subtract running mean: x - mean
Divide by standard deviation: sqrt(running variance) + 0.000001
Multiply scale, add bias: Learned channel-wise affine transform

g.text: k=2, s=1: pad right/bottom with negative infinity.
That pool preserves its input spatial size.

g.data-description: Flatten C, H, W: 12,544 features; channel-major
Linear: 12,544 inputs; 1,470 outputs; bias
Activation: Identity for the final prediction vector
g.text: Identity for the final prediction vector

g.data-description: Raw prediction tensor: Field selection is explicit in the three branches
g.text: Field selection is explicit in the three branches

g.aria-label: Select xy; add grid; divide by 7
g.data-label: Select xy; add grid; divide by 7
g.data-description: Select xy; add grid; divide by 7: Centers scaled to 448 pixels
g.text: Select xy; add grid; divide by 7

g.data-description: Select wh; square dimensions: Scale dimensions to 448 pixels
Select confidence and class values: Multiply; 20 scores for each of 98 boxes
g.text: Multiply; 20 scores for each of 98 boxes

g.data-description: Stack cx, cy, width, height: Convert to corner coordinates
Confidence filter + class NMS: Then invert resize to the original image
g.text: Then invert resize to the original image
VOC 20 classes. No anchors. Shared class values per 7 × 7 cell; 2 boxes per cell. Stretch preprocessing.
Source: darknet/cfgs/yolov1-tiny.cfg; darknet/net.py; darknet/blocks.py. Revision a4d0ecc9e17f.
